questions.stem: If the supplier ___ on time, we will start the production on Monday.

why_wrong: A : Prétérit : type 2, incompatible avec « will » dans la principale.
C : « would » : irréel, pas dans la proposition en « if » réelle.
D : Pas de « will » après « if ».
fr.example: If it rains, we will stay.

why_wrong: A: Past: type 2, inconsistent with 'will' in the main clause.
C: 'would': unreal, not in a real 'if' clause.
D: No 'will' after 'if'.
en.example: If it rains, we will stay.

questions.stem: If I ___ the manager, I would give everyone a raise.

why_wrong: A : Irréel du présent : prétérit (were).
B : Pas de « would » après « if ».
D : Pas de « will » après « if ».
fr.example: If I were you, I would wait.

why_wrong: A: Unreal present: past tense (were).
B: No 'would' after 'if'.
D: No 'will' after 'if'.
en.example: If I were you, I would wait.

questions.stem: If we had received the payment earlier, we ___ the order on time.

fr.rule: Type 3 : if + had + p.p., would have + p.p.
why_wrong: A : Prétérit : incompatible avec l'irréel du passé.
C : Irréel du passé : would have + participe.
D : Futur : incompatible avec « had received ».
fr.example: If I had known, I would have called.

en.rule: Type 3: if + had + p.p., would have + p.p.
why_wrong: A: Simple past: inconsistent with the unreal past.
C: Unreal past: would have + participle.
D: Future: inconsistent with 'had received'.
en.example: If I had known, I would have called.

questions.stem: ___ you need further assistance, please call our help desk.

why_wrong: A : « Did you need » : question au passé.
C : « Had » demande un participe passé.
D : « Would you need » n'est pas une inversion conditionnelle.
fr.example: Should you have questions, call me.

why_wrong: A: 'Did you need': a past question.
C: 'Had' requires a past participle.
D: 'Would you need' is not a conditional inversion.
en.example: Should you have questions, call me.

questions.stem: ___ we known about the delay, we would have chosen another carrier.

fr.rule: Had + sujet + p.p. = if + had + p.p.
why_wrong: A : « Should we known » est impossible.
C : « Would we known » est impossible.
D : « Were we known » est impossible.
fr.example: Had I known, I would have gone.

en.rule: Had + subject + p.p. = if + had + p.p.
why_wrong: A: 'Should we known' is impossible.
C: 'Would we known' is impossible.
D: 'Were we known' is impossible.
en.example: Had I known, I would have gone.

questions.stem: You can leave early ___ you finish all your tasks.

fr.rule: as long as = à condition que.
why_wrong: A : Préposition : pas de proposition ensuite.
B : « even if » : concession, autre sens.
D : « unless » = à moins que : sens opposé.
fr.example: You may stay as long as you like.

why_wrong: A: Preposition: no clause after it.
B: 'even if': concession, different meaning.
D: 'unless' = if not: opposite meaning.
en.example: You may stay as long as you like.

questions.stem: We will cancel the event ___ enough people register.

why_wrong: A : « provided » seul est incomplet.
B : Contresens : l'annulation dépend de l'absence d'inscriptions.
D : But : mauvais sens.
fr.example: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.

why_wrong: A: 'provided' alone is incomplete.
B: Wrong sense: cancellation depends on lack of registrations.
D: Purpose: wrong meaning.
en.example: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.

questions.stem: If it ___ tomorrow, the outdoor event will be moved indoors.

why_wrong: A : Prétérit : incompatible avec « will be moved ».
B : Pas de « will » après « if ».
C : Pas de « would » après « if » dans un conditionnel réel.
A: Past: inconsistent with 'will be moved'.
B: No 'will' after 'if'.
C: No 'would' after 'if' in a real conditional.
